roster_grade.headline: 9-1 and #1 by record — hold the lineup, turn spare QBs and bench vets into a young RB
roster_grade.window_explanation: #1 by record (9-1), #2 in points for (725, just behind dickcole2410's 736), but only #6 by roster value. That's a win-now profile: protect every producing starter and spend true surplus (QB3/QB4, bench vets, picks) on the one soft spot, an aging RB room.

strengths.label: Best record in the league
strengths.detail: 9-1 with 725 points for. Two games clear of everyone; dickcole2410 (7-3, 736 PF) and Rolling Ball (7-3) are the closest.

strengths.label: QB depth nobody else has
strengths.detail: Mahomes, Shough, Nix, and Jalon Daniels. Superflex only starts two, so Shough (once Mahomes is back in the lineup) and Daniels are the trade chips.

strengths.label: Deep WR group
strengths.detail: Parker Washington, Watson, and Higgins start, DeVonta Smith is a quality WR4, and Stribling is on IR. WR need is only 0.06.

strengths.label: Loveland plus extra picks
strengths.detail: Young TE1 in Loveland, plus an extra 2028 1st and 2027 2nd to deal from.

weaknesses.label: Aging RB room
weaknesses.detail: Henry (32), Javonte (26), Hubbard (27), and Kamara (31) are all Declining. RB need is 0.4, the only real need on the roster.

weaknesses.label: Value lags the record
weaknesses.detail: #6 by roster value, down from #5 last week. You're outscoring your talent, so some regression risk.

weaknesses.label: Thin RB depth
weaknesses.detail: RJ Harvey (1,873) is in the lineup. One more RB injury and Kamara or Hubbard is starting.

roster_grade.most_urgent_action: Turn Tyler Shough into a young RB: Shough + RJ Harvey for Jeremiyah Love (Lemon Party, 0-10, weak at QB and RB). First confirm Mahomes is healthy — he's been on the bench two weeks running and Shough is in the lineup. If Mahomes is out, lead instead with Hubbard + Zavion Thomas for Bucky Irving (Buck-ee's). Keep Mahomes, Henry, and every starting WR.

QB.commentary: Four QBs for two slots, QB need 0.0. Nix and Shough are starting while Mahomes sits — check why. Once he's back, Shough and Daniels are pure surplus.

RB.commentary: Henry and Javonte are producing, but every vet is Declining and Harvey is filling a starting slot. This is the upgrade target (need 0.4).

WR.commentary: Three solid starters, Smith as WR4, Stribling on IR. Smith is the one WR you could move for an RB.

TE.commentary: Loveland is the long-term TE1 and Hockenson is a starting TE2/flex. Need is just 0.03.

trade_priority_order: Shough + RJ Harvey → Jeremiyah Love (Lemon Party, 0-10, weak at QB/RB/WR) — once Mahomes is confirmed healthy
Hubbard + Zavion Thomas → Bucky Irving (Buck-ee's, Long shot, weak at WR)
Jalon Daniels + Malik Washington + 2028 2nd → Breece Hall (Bijan Mustard, 2-8, selling)
All-in option: Shough + Javonte Williams + 2027 2nd + 2028 3rd → Bijan Robinson (Bijan Mustard)
Sell Kamara to an RB-needy contender (Rolling Ball) for a 2027 3rd
Hold Mahomes, Henry, Loveland, and the starting WRs — you're 9-1

sell_now.urgency: This week, once Mahomes is back
sell_now.reason: Your QB3 when Mahomes plays, and 0-10 Lemon Party is weak at QB. His value is highest while a seller still needs a starter.
QB4 who will never start for you. Rebuilders like a rookie QB, so he works as a package piece in an RB deal.
Bench RB, 27 and Declining. Spend him as the main piece for a younger RB on a seller.
31-year-old bench RB, and his value only drops from here.

buy_now.reason: 0-10 and weak at QB, RB, and WR. Shough + Harvey fills two of their holes for one rookie RB. Values: 6,075 out vs 5,976 in.
Long shot and weak at WR. Two bench pieces for a 24-year-old starting RB, with no starter leaving your lineup.
2-8 and selling, and Hall is on their bench. A rookie QB, a WR, and a pick for a young RB.
2-8 and selling. The all-in: Mahomes, Henry, Nix, and Harvey all stay.

do_not_trade: Derrick Henry — producing starter on a 9-1 team
Parker Washington / Tee Higgins / Christian Watson — starting WRs
trade_strategy.pick_strategy: You're 9-1, so picks are currency. Use 2nds through 4ths, including the extra 2027 2nd, to close gaps on RB deals. Hold the extra 2028 1st and your own 2027 1st unless they land Bijan or Love outright.

outlook.projected_power_rank: #2 composite title odds (#1 record, #2 PF, #6 value). Top seed if the lineup holds.
outlook.three_year_outlook: Win now on the Mahomes/Loveland/WR core. A young RB this season (Love, Irving, Hall, or Bijan) also covers 2027, when Henry and Javonte age out.
outlook.season_narrative: The Jabroni Beaters are 9-1 at Week 5 — best record in the league and #2 in points — while ranking #6 in roster value. The lineup works, so protect it and fix the aging RB room. Four QBs for two slots and five Long shot teams to deal with means Shough, Daniels, and Hubbard can buy a young RB without touching a starter.
key_risks: Regression, since you're outscoring your roster value (#6)
Mahomes on the bench two weeks running — if he's hurt, Shough is a starter and not spendable
An RB injury now that Harvey is already in the lineup
key_upside_factors: Landing Love, Irving, Hall, or Bijan makes RB a strength
Stribling back from IR deepens WR
Extra 2028 1st and 2027 2nd to spend at the deadline
